auszuege.business: Cambricon Technologies Corporation Limited engages in the research, development, design, and sale of core AI chips for terminal devices in China. The company offers cloud-based intelligent chips and boards, intelligent complete machines, edge intelligence chips and boards, and related supporting basic system software. It also provides smart accelerator cards, including the Siyuan 370 and Siyuan 270 series; intelligent computing modules comprising the Siyuan 220 module; terminal intelligent processor IP, which consists of Cambricon-1M and Cambricon-1H; and software development platforms, such as the Cambricon NeuWare and MagicMind. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Beijing, China.
